title: Server, VM, CPU, RAM, OS, and lifecycle fields
description: Hardware profile records and lifecycle metadata for assets
spec:
1. Persist CPU model/count, RAM, disk/storage allocation, OS, platform, hypervisor, and hardware model.
2. Persist VM fields (guest OS, vCPU, vRAM, virtual disks, host, cluster, tools status, snapshot notes).
3. Persist physical-host fields (chassis/model, serial, host role, cluster, VM count, totals).
4. Persist lifecycle fields (purchase, warranty, support end, planned replacement, decommission).
5. Surface these on the asset detail hardware/virtualization sections.
6. Verify create/update round-trips via API and UI.
